modalities.value: images/documents to text (OCR VLM with visual tokens and text prompts)

source.quote:
The encoder discretizes images into visual tokens,
while the decoder generates outputs conditioned on these visual tokens and text prompts.

architecture.value: DeepEncoder V2 (80M SAM tokenizer + Qwen2-0.5B LM-style encoder with causal flow queries / dual attention) + DeepSeek 3B MoE decoder; visual tokens 256–1120

source.quote:
DeepSeek-OCR 2 inherits the overall architecture of DeepSeek-OCR,
which consists of an encoder and a decoder.

trainingData.value: same sources as DeepSeek-OCR: OCR 1.0, OCR 2.0, and general vision data; OCR data 80% of mixture

source.quote:
DeepSeek-OCR 2 employs the same data sources as DeepSeek-OCR, comprising OCR 1.0, OCR

mixture.
